card.name: Minus sign in numeric ranges
card.fires_on: A minus sign, en dash or decimal point right inside a number, usually where a negative value or range begins, such as a confidence interval or a change from baseline in a results table.

modes.label: Range start in tables
modes.description: A parenthesis or dash opening a range of values after a mean in a pharmacokinetic interaction table.

modes.label: Negative number or interval
modes.description: The decimal point or minus inside a negative value or confidence interval in trial results.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a negative number or a range of values is starting in a results table.
